title: Regional Sales Manager*in (m/w/d)
description: At HEY HOLY, our mission is simple: help dogs live longer, healthier lives through better nutrition. Instead of creating one-size-fits-all products, we develop breed-specific nutrition designed around the unique needs of every dog. Developed alongside veterinary experts, our products are helping thousands of dogs across Germany live healthier lives every day. Since launching in 2022, we've grown into one of Germany's fastest-growing DTC pet nutrition brands, serving over 20,000 dogs through our subscription model. As our Regional Sales Manager, your mission is simple: Build the highest-performing field sales team in Germany. You'll be the bridge between leadership and our field sales team, ensuring every field sales agent has the coaching, tools, confidence and accountability needed to consistently perform at their best. This is a hands-on leadership role that balances several things: recruiting and onboarding new team members, coaching on the ground, hosting trainings, coordinating the team day-to-day, and managing it on both a personnel and a performance level. You'll spend meaningful time out in the field alongside the team, mostly in the Frankfurt region, but just as much time building the team: developing training programmes, shaping onboarding, supporting new starters, analysing performance, and working closely with leadership to continuously raise the bar. Success in this role isn't measured by your own sales - it's measured by the success of the people you recruit, develop, and lead. Tasks Further build the team: Own hiring, onboarding, and training for every field sales agent - giving them the knowledge, confidence, and skills to perform from day one Coach on the ground: Be present where it counts, through regular stand visits, live feedback, and structured development plans that turn good agents into great ones Drive performance: Own the numbers that matter - sales, customer experience, and retention - using data and field observations to spot trends, strengths, and where to intervene Have the fun and the hard conversations: Hold honest performance discussions, build clear improvement plans where they're needed, and recognise and reward strong performers - always keeping the bar high Protect the standard: Ensure the sales process, stand presentation, and brand experience stay consistently excellent across every event, and keep the team sharp with refresher trainings and workshops as we grow Build the culture: Create a team defined by ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement - and set the tone by leading from the front whenever you're in the field Partner with leadership: Work closely with the Head of Direct Sales and the Events Coordinator to raise performance and operational standards across the board Requirements Sales Experience: You bring first experience leading, coaching, or developing sales teams, ideally gained in retail or face-to-face customer acquisition - yet not a must. Passion for Developing People : You genuinely enjoy helping others improve. You get satisfaction from seeing individuals grow into confident, high-performing sales professionals. Performance Mindset : You understand that great coaching exists to drive measurable results. You know how to set expectations, monitor progress and improve performance through structured coaching. Leadership Through Action: You earn credibility through your own behaviours, professionalism and standards. Excellent Communication : Whether you're motivating a top performer or delivering difficult feedback, you're clear, honest and respectful. Adaptability : No two events are the same. You stay calm, practical and solutions-focused when plans change or challenges arise. Local Presence and Communication Skills: You speak fluent German (C1+) and confident English, and are happy to travel regularly across the Frankfurt region. Benefits ⏰ A varied working week – Enjoy a mix of remote working, office collaboration and hands-on coaching out in the field. 💡 Real ownership – Shape how one of Germany's fastest-growing field sales teams develops. 📈 Grow with us – As HEY HOLY scales, so will your responsibility, influence and career opportunities. 🚀 See your impact every day – Your coaching directly influences the performance of the entire business. 💬 Open and honest communication – We believe in trust, direct feedback and continuous improvement. 📚 Personal learning budget – We invest in your professional development because great leaders never stop learning. 🎟 Corporate Benefits & Wellpass 🐶 Free HEY HOLY dog food 🎉 28 days holiday plus Christmas Eve and New Year's Eve off We Value Diversity 🌈 We believe the strongest teams are built from different experiences, perspectives and ideas. That's why we welcome applications regardless of age, gender identity, ethnicity, disability, religion, sexual orientation or background. What matters most to us is your ability to help others succeed, raise standards and contribute to a culture built on ownership, collaboration and continuous improvement. Because together, we can help even more dogs live longer, healthier lives. See our full JEDI statement on our website. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Direct Response Copywriter DE & EN (AI First, Marketing Agency)
description: Hey, ich bin Yannic, Co-Founder von agencro, eine CRO- und Direct-Response-Agentur für E-Commerce-Brands: Advertorials, Landingpages, Online-Shops und Email für unsere Kunden - dazu eigene Projekte, für die wir auch selbst Paid Ads schalten. Wir arbeiten AI-first: AI übernimmt das Volumen, ein kleines Team mit Urteil und Geschmack dirigiert und veredelt. Kleines Remote-Team, kurze Wege, deine Arbeit geht schnell live. Alles, was wir bauen, steht und fällt mit der Copy: Advertorials, Landingpages, Emails - und die Ads für unsere eigenen Brands. Da kommst du ins Spiel: Du schreibst die Copy, die diese Seiten und Ads zum Konvertieren bringt - auf Basis klarer Angles und Briefings von unserem Head of Direct Response & CRO. Ein klassischer Copywriting-Job ist das nicht: Die erste Fassung schreibt AI mit dir. Bezahlt wirst du für Urteil, Research-Tiefe und Feinschliff - den Unterschied zwischen generischem Output und Copy, die verkauft. Aufgaben Direct-Response-Copy schreiben: Advertorials, Landingpages, Produktseiten und Emails für unsere Kunden-Projekte - vom gebrieften Angle bis zum fertigen Text. Ad-Copy: Hooks, Scripts und Primary Text für Paid Social. AI-first arbeiten: Drafts, Varianten und Research mit AI als Default - dein Urteil und dein Feinschliff machen daraus Copy, die konvertiert. Research: Zielgruppen, Pains, Awareness-Stufen und Wettbewerber verstehen, bevor du schreibst. Gute Copy beginnt dort. Auf Daten iterieren: Testergebnisse und Feedback aufnehmen, schnell überarbeiten und mit jeder Runde schärfer werden. Briefings hinterfragen: wenn ein Angle nicht trägt, sag es - und schlag einen besseren vor. Qualifikation Wen wir NICHT suchen Brand- und Awareness-Texter - unsere Copy muss verkaufen. AI-Skeptiker. AI ist bei uns der Default, kein Gimmick. Literarische Perfektionisten. Klarheit schlägt Cleverness. Texter, die Feedback persönlich nehmen - Iteration ist der Job. Wen wir suchen Du verstehst Direct Response: Angles, Awareness-Stufen, Einwände, Proof, CTAs. Du schreibst bereits täglich mit AI, holst starken Output raus - und weißt, wann du sie überstimmen musst. Starker Research-Muskel und echte Neugier auf Zielgruppen. Sehr gutes Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau. Schnell, verlässlich, selbstorganisiert - du hältst Deadlines ohne Drama. Benefits Im Gegenzug für diese Skills arbeitest Du in einem Team aus jungen, dynamischen Leuten, kannst Deinen Tag so gestalten wie Du willst, arbeiten von wo Du willst und wirst jeden Tag aufs neue gechallenged. Du siehst unterschiedlichste Projekte im eCommerce von Health über Beauty und Fitness bis hin zu Fashion und bekommst einen unglaublich tiefen Einblick in die Welt des Online Marketings. Statt wochenlang an einer Sache zu sitzen, wechseln Deine Aufgaben im Tagestakt, sodass es Dir nie langweilig wird. Es gibt immer eine Challenge zu lösen, ein Projekt zu pushen oder einen Prozess zu verbessern. Bewerbung Schick uns 3-5 Funnels, Advertorials oder Ads, die du geschrieben oder verantwortet hast - idealerweise mit Ergebnissen (CVR, CPA, Spend, Test-Wins). Ein kurzer Absatz: dein AI-Workflow heute - welche Tools, wofür, wo dein Handwerk reinkommt. Nächste Schritte: Kennenlern-Gespräch, Probeaufgabe, Video-Call. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

 This role is about taking our platform to the next level: moving toward sophisticated, predictive, and learning-based decisioning, with a clear path toward becoming a regulated medical device.

This is a senior, high-impact individual contributor (IC) role for someone who combines deep system understanding with clinical product judgement and real experience deploying AI/ML. With our flagship ThinkTrader platform, we make it available for our clients to trade the world 24-hours a day. We use the latest technologies to give traders seamless access to our proprietary trading platforms. We are seeking a Marketing Analytics and Technology Manager to oversee the implementation and optimization of marketing technology solutions, data analysis, and revenue attribution. Key Responsibilities: Data Analysis and Insights: Collect and analyze marketing data from various channels (paid media, social media, email, etc.) to evaluate campaign performance and customer behavior. Revenue Tracking and Attribution: Develop and maintain models for accurate revenue attribution across marketing touchpoints. Analytics and Reporting: Build and maintain dashboards to report on key performance indicators (KPIs), conversion rates, and ROI. Data Layers and Technology Integration: Develop and manage data layers for analytics tools like Google Tag Manager, ensuring data accuracy and consistency across platforms. Expertise in marketing attribution models and analytics tools such as Google Analytics, Mixpanel, and Google Tag Manager. Experience with marketing technology integrations (e.g., CRM, email, and analytics platforms) and data management. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to deliver actionable insights and optimize marketing efforts. title: SVP, Data & Tech Lead
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p></div><p><strong>2830 - SVP, Data &amp; Tech Lead - GCS</strong></p> <p><strong>Role Summary and Impact</strong></p> <p><em>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We use the power of creativity to build better futures for our people, planet, clients and communities. WPP Media is WPP's global media collective, bringing together the best platforms, people, and partners to create limitless opportunities for growth in a world where media is Everywhere.&nbsp; </em></p> <p>This role is within the Data, Tech, and Analytics (DTA) team, within the Global Client Solutions organisation. The Global Client Solutions (GCS) team is responsible for all global clients within WPP. DTA is responsible for servicing clients with best-in-class data solutions, data strategy, analytics, technology and AI solutions to drive client growth. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers. We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection.</p> <p><strong>SVP, Data &amp; Tech Lead</strong></p> <p>As the Global Client Data &amp; Tech Lead, you will take ownership of driving data-led transformation for one of WPP’s largest and most ambitious global clients. You will be at the forefront of enabling data, technology, and AI to create more impactful brand experiences and measurable business growth.</p> <p>You will be a strategic partner to WPP Media’s Global Client Leads, defining what ‘data-driven’ marketing looks like for your client across Discovery, Planning, Activation, and Measurement. You will act as a senior advisor to CMOs and other key stakeholders and will guide them in building the data capabilities and infrastructure needed to achieve their marketing goals while ensuring responsible and effective use of data.</p> <p>This role demands a leader who can combine thought leadership, operational expertise, strong line management, and a deep understanding of data and technology to deliver tangible results. You will assemble and lead a team of experts to implement strategies, deploy solutions, and build long-term capability for your client.</p> <p><strong>Skills and Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Own Client Data Narrative &amp; Drive Growth:</strong> Build strategic relationships with key client stakeholders, including CMOs, IT, and Finance leaders. Develop a deep understanding of client objectives and advise on how data, technology, and AI can drive impact and growth. Act as a trusted advisor, helping clients navigate complex challenges and opportunities in data-driven marketing. Partner with the Global Account Director/Client President to co-create and execute the Global Client Growth Plan.</li> <li><strong>Data Strategy Expertise:</strong> Assemble and lead a team of data strategists to define the role of data for media and advertising on the client business. Define how first-party data should be collected, organized, and deployed across business units. Identify and execute data partnerships to enrich and extend first-party data. Standardize data usage across markets and business units to achieve marketing objectives.</li> <li><strong>Measurement &amp; Optimization Frameworks:</strong> Oversee the design and implementation of measurement frameworks that balance short- and long-term value creation. Define growth targets and metrics for marketing effectiveness. Define and deploy use of data science techniques to better predict growth from audience-based, omnichannel approaches. Introduce AI-powered optimization tools to enhance efficiency and performance within and across channels. Ensure timely and actionable reporting for visibility into performance.</li> <li><strong>Technology Consulting and Implementation</strong>: Assemble and lead a team to evaluate clients’ technology ecosystems and recommend improvements to enhance performance and reduce costs. Oversee the implementation of cloud data management, martech, adtech, AI, and analytics systems. Integrate WPP Data, Tech, and media solutions into the client’s broader technology stack to accelerate results.</li> <li><strong>Capability Building and Education</strong>: Educate WPP client teams on WPP’s data capabilities, tools, and priorities. Provide visible leadership, coaching, and mentorship to inspire teams and foster innovation in data, technology, and AI.</li> </ul> <p><strong>WHAT YOU WILL NEED</strong></p> <ul> <li>Relevant industry experience, including significant time in an agency environment.</li> <li>Proven experience operating at a senior client leadership level or engaging with high-profile stakeholders.</li> <li>Demonstrated thought leadership and expertise in data, technology, and AI within the marketing industry.</li> <li>A track record of solving complex problems and delivering measurable business success through data-driven strategies.</li> <li>Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to influence teams, clients, and colleagues positively.</li> <li>Exceptional communication skills, capable of simplifying complex concepts for diverse audiences.</li> <li>Experience building and managing large, diverse teams of data, technology, and analytics specialists.</li> <li>Strategic and operational agility, with the ability to adapt quickly in dynamic environments.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Life at WPP Media &amp; Benefits</strong></p> <p>Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to&nbsp;Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also&nbsp;Lead Optimistically,&nbsp;firmly believing&nbsp;in and&nbsp;Championing Growth and Development&nbsp;for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to&nbsp;leverage&nbsp;the extensive global WPP Media &amp; WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the&nbsp;cutting edge&nbsp;of marketing and advertising.&nbsp;</p> <p>We&nbsp;Create an Open environment&nbsp;built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in-office events&nbsp;showcasing&nbsp;team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.&nbsp;</p> <p>WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We believe the best work happens when&nbsp;we're&nbsp;together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection in this open and supportive environment.&nbsp;That's&nbsp;why&nbsp;we’ve&nbsp;adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you&nbsp;require&nbsp;accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.&nbsp; Please note that while our philosophy is the same across WPP, benefits may vary by office/country.</p> <p><em>Please note this is a UK based role and requires individuals to have the right to work in this location</em></p> <p>Please read our Privacy Notice (<a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy">https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy)</a> for more information on how we process the information you provide.</p> <p>While we appreciate all applications received, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.&nbsp;</p> <p>#LI-Promoted</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p></p> <p><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">Please read our <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy#:~:text=WPP%20Media%20Privacy%20Notice%20for%20Recruitment">Privacy Notice</a></span></span><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto">&nbsp;<span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">for more information on how we process the information you provide.</span></span><span class="EOP SCXW227196529 BCX8" data-ccp-props="{&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:276}">&nbsp;</span></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p></div><p><strong>3048 - Director, Planning, UK</strong></p> <p><strong>Role Summary and Impact</strong></p> <p>EssenceMediacom, part of WPP, is a new breed of media agency. Grounded in analytics &amp; insights and powered by data &amp; technology, we believe in the power of media and creative to drive breakthroughs for the world’s best brands. We help clients understand the modern marketing paradox and discover the breakthroughs brands need to win with their consumers. We are designed for the new communications economy — built on data &amp; technology, built for people &amp; algorithms, built around diverse schools of thought, built to test &amp; learn at scale, and, crucially, built to evolve.</p> <p><strong>The Role:</strong></p> <p>In this role you will work across the EE/BT consumer account, focusing on EE’s brand activity across a variety of products including Mobile, Broadband, TV and Gaming, as well as Masterbrand.</p> <p><strong>Position/Title: Business Director - Brand</strong></p> <p>We’re looking for a highly experienced, smart planner who loves both new ideas and the craft.&nbsp; EE/BT is one of the biggest advertisers in the UK, so our benchmark is not work that’s merely good enough - it has to be great.</p> <p><strong>Practice Summary:</strong></p> <p>As planners we’re the conductors of the orchestra that is paid [and beyond] media.&nbsp; We work collaboratively with Strategy and Activation to ensure our approach is fully integrated across POES.&nbsp; We search for insight and intelligence so that we can build innovative media plans, owning the process and incorporating cross-channel budget allocation, in-flight cross-channel optimisation, reporting and post-campaign analysis. We are our clients’ key contacts for a unified view across all aspects of their campaigns.</p> <p><strong>Position Summary:</strong></p> <p>The Business Director will oversee media campaigns with support from more junior planners and assist the Client Lead in ensuring our work is delivered to the highest quality. They will be responsible for elevating our agency's strategic planning function through a robust, data-first approach. This role is key to integrating advanced analytical capabilities with creative strategic development, ensuring our recommendations are always evidence-based and ahead of the curve. They will demonstrate a thorough knowledge of the overall media landscape and available research, using these to inform and communicate planning recommendations. The Business Director has oversight and responsibility for the day-to-day management of media plans, working to fulfill the client’s media strategy in the context of changing market conditions. They are responsible for ensuring investment is optimal to deliver campaign objectives, via effective planning.</p> <p><strong>Our clients:</strong></p> <p>We work across the EE/BT group.&nbsp; Although their public faces are very different, the two brands are managed very closely together.&nbsp; They’re one of the nation’s biggest spenders, and some of our most-loved brands.&nbsp; They are genuinely important to the nation with their creation and management of the UK’s connectivity networks, and we reflect that importance with how we try to help consumers and give them useful solutions in a modern world.</p> <p><strong>Our team:</strong></p> <p>Team Connect is a very big team that is 100% allocated to EE, BT and Plusnet.&nbsp; A successful candidate can expect to work on multiple aspects of these brands. This includes broadband, mobile, TV, as well as Masterbrand. This role is purely Brand focused but will involve close collaboration with Performance planners.</p> <p><strong>Skills and Experience:</strong></p> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong><strong>Essential Functions/Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Maintain fantastic relationships with key clients in media and marketing teams.</li> <li>Ensure the delivery of high-quality response presentations, actionable weekly reporting, insightful post campaign analyses and clear briefs to Activation.</li> <li>Deliver clear and compelling rationale to support media investment recommendations and to evidence campaign performance versus expected outcomes.</li> <li>Spearhead the integration of data analytics and insights into the core of our strategic planning processes, ensuring data is used proactively and upfront in all client engagements and internal initiatives.</li> <li>Accelerate AI adoption and transformation across the team, ensuring we are regularly sharing work and that clients see the tangible benefits of WPP Open.</li> <li>Take a lead role in developing and presenting best-in-class Strategic Response to Briefs (RTBs).</li> <li>Support ADs in delivering Media Detail RTBs and in briefing Activation teams.</li> <li>Work closely with the Head of Strategy &amp; Planning on wider cross-portfolio strategic workstreams.</li> <li>Oversee and quality assure all deliverables produced by junior team members.</li> <li>Work with Activation and Analytics in the delivery and measurement of plans.</li> <li>Take responsibility for the performance of assigned media budgets against intended outcomes.</li> <li>Be a point of escalation for team issues (within and outside the team).</li> <li>Contribute to internal thought leadership and team process/workflow enhancement, to increase work quality and efficiency.</li> <li>Line-manage 3 direct reports (AD, AM, SAE), supporting their career development and driving job satisfaction.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Competencies (specific knowledge, skills and abilities)</strong></p> <ul> <li>Advanced knowledge of media landscape, media metric calculations and measurement techniques.</li> <li>Thorough understanding of industry standard media research tools (ComScore, Touchpoints, TGI, YouGov).</li> <li>Demonstrable expertise in understanding, interpreting, and applying various data sources (e.g., market research, digital analytics, social listening, econometrics, CRM data, first-party data).</li> <li>Deep understanding of current market trends, consumer behaviour, and the evolving media landscape.</li> <li>Superb client relationship and management skills.</li> <li>Outstanding verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to translate complex data and insights into clear, compelling narratives for diverse audiences. (internal teams, clients, senior leadership).</li> <li>Highly collaborative, comfortable working cross-functionally with data, analytics, research, and creative teams.</li> <li>Proven track record of leading, inspiring, and upskilling more junior planners, fostering a culture of curiosity and continuous learning.</li> <li>Excellent organisational skills, close attention to detail and ability to quality-control work.</li> <li>Forecast expected outcomes of brand and performance campaigns and manage investment accordingly.</li> <li>Basic spreadsheet capabilities (VLOOKUP, Pivot Table) are a must.</li> <li>Superior presentation design skills, in slides or document format.</li> <li>Ability to adhere to deadlines and project manage multiple campaigns.</li> <li>Development and maintenance of productive relationships with media owner partners.</li> <li>Proven problem solving and decision-making skills.</li> <li>Ability to work independently and to collaborate in a team environment.</li> <li>Skilled in quantitative reasoning.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Management Responsibility</strong></p> <ul> <li>Motivate a team, leading by example while coaching juniors - cultivating a dynamic and inquisitive culture where hypothesis-driven thinking is central to problem-solving.</li> <li>Provide timely and actionable feedback to aid in team development and improvement.</li> <li>Monitor and support satisfaction across the team, identifying and implementing ways to maintain or increase satisfaction.</li> <li>Foster strong working relationships across the team to facilitate flawless execution of plans.</li> <li>Communicate effectively across all levels of the team, understanding when to escalate issues to leadership.</li> <li>Calculate the workload implication of new campaigns and feed into resource management.</li> <li>Provide awareness and recognition for jobs well done.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Required Education and Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>At least six to eight years of experience in a pure planning role.</li> <li>Demonstrable interest and expertise in planning craft.</li> <li>Data literate with demonstrable expertise in understanding, interpreting, and applying various data sources.</li> <li>Mastery of planning/insight tools such as eTelmar, TGI, YouGov, WARC, etc.</li> <li>Strong experience and interest in dedicated planning tools.</li> <li>Interest and knowledge of Planning and Media trends and issues.</li> <li>Proven experience in media at Senior Manager level.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Life at WPP Media &amp; Benefits</strong></p> <p>Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also Lead Optimistically,&nbsp;firmly believing&nbsp;in and Championing Growth and Development for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to&nbsp;leverage&nbsp;the extensive global WPP Media &amp; WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the&nbsp;cutting edge&nbsp;of marketing and advertising.&nbsp;</p> <p>We Create an Open environment built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in-office events&nbsp;showcasing&nbsp;team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.&nbsp;</p> <p>WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection in this open and supportive environment. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.&nbsp;</p> <p>Please note this is a UK based role and requires individuals to have the right to work in this location.</p> <p>Please read our Privacy Notice (<a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy">https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy</a>) for more information on how we process the information you provide.&nbsp;</p> <p>While we appreciate all applications received, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.&nbsp;</p> <p>#LI-Promoted</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p></p> <p><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">Please read our <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy#:~:text=WPP%20Media%20Privacy%20Notice%20for%20Recruitment">Privacy Notice</a></span></span><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto">&nbsp;<span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">for more information on how we process the information you provide.</span></span><span class="EOP SCXW227196529 BCX8" data-ccp-props="{&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:276}">&nbsp;</span></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><h4><strong>Join Axon and be a Force for Good.</strong></h4> <p>At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.<br><br>Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.</p></div><p><strong>JOB DESCRIPTION</strong></p> <p><strong>Senior Manager, International Indirect Tax</strong></p> <ul> <li>Location: Mon remotely, Tue-Fri in-office (London, Amsterdam, Frankfurt, or Madrid)</li> <li>Reporting to: VP, Tax</li> <li>Reports: no formal direct reports, with broad influence on the global tax organization</li> </ul> <p>At Axon, we are on a mission to Protect Life. We build and deploy technology across public safety and justice, and we hold ourselves to high standards in how we operate — including in how we manage our obligations as a global business.</p> <p><strong>Your Impact</strong></p> <p>Axon is seeking a Senior Manager, International Indirect Tax to lead the company's international VAT and indirect tax function, encompassing all non-US VAT and indirect taxes. The role carries overall responsibility for the quality and accuracy of all indirect tax compliance output, as well as providing advisory support to internal teams on indirect tax matters arising from contracts, new market entry, entity set-up, and tax law changes.</p> <p>The successful candidate will be commercially minded, technically strong across European and global VAT systems, experienced in indirect tax compliance, and confident advising Finance, Legal, and Commercial colleagues without requiring escalation. The role supervises three indirect tax team members, reporting directly to the Vice President, Tax.&nbsp; Experience in a hardware and software business with a complex supply chain is highly desired.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></p> <p><strong>Internal Advisory</strong></p> <ul> <li>Act as the primary point of contact for non-US indirect tax queries across Finance, Legal, and Commercial teams.</li> <li>Liaise with sales teams and other partners to understand upstream sales processes that impact indirect tax operationalization and compliance matters.</li> <li>Advise on the VAT treatment of customer contracts, pricing structures, and invoicing arrangements, working directly with Sales and Legal as required.</li> <li>Provide VAT guidance on new product lines and SKU launches, including taxability assessments and sales tax code assignments in D365.</li> <li>Represent the indirect tax function in e-invoicing projects and regulatory change programmes.</li> <li>Support the business through tax authority audits, enquiries, and disputes.</li> <li>Monitor legislative developments across relevant jurisdictions and communicate implications to the business.</li> <li>Advise and inform management on growing areas of focus in non-US indirect compliance and audits, technology trends and solutions, and process improvements.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compliance Oversight</strong></p> <ul> <li>Review and approve all indirect tax compliance deliverables — VAT returns, Intrastat, OSS, and ESL — across all in-scope jurisdictions, with full accountability for accuracy and submission deadlines.</li> <li>Oversee indirect tax accounting, including journal entries, balance sheet reconciliations, and BlackLine certification.</li> <li>Maintain the compliance calendar and validate data quality across all submissions.</li> <li>Monitor VAT payments and refunds; liaise with local tax authorities where required.</li> <li>Provide guidance to Finance and operational teams on compliance requirements as they arise.</li> </ul> <p><strong>New Entity Set-Up</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead the indirect tax workstream for all new entity formations, covering VAT registration, system readiness, and the preparation of compliant workpaper frameworks prior to first filing.</li> <li>Review and approve invoice templates for new entities before they commence trading.</li> <li>Ensure SOX and internal control obligations are met across all indirect tax processes.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Process and Systems</strong></p> <ul> <li>Identify and implement improvements to VAT filing workflows, including the use of AI, macros, Alteryx, and D365 configuration.</li> <li>Participate in or lead system testing for indirect tax-related ERP and reporting changes.</li> <li>Maintain commodity code tax tables and item sales tax code frameworks in D365.</li> <li>Ensure processes are documented and structured to support an expanding compliance footprint.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You Bring</strong></p> <ul> <li>A minimum of 10 years' experience in VAT or indirect tax, gained in-house at a multinational or in a professional services environment.</li> <li>Detailed working knowledge of VAT across multiple European jurisdictions, including Intrastat, OSS, and ESL reporting obligations.</li> <li>Demonstrable experience reviewing and approving compliance deliverables prepared by others, with personal accountability for quality and timeliness.</li> <li>Experience advising on the indirect tax treatment of commercial contracts, pricing arrangements, and customer invoicing.</li> <li>Experience managing the indirect tax aspects of new entity set-ups, including VAT registration and process build-out.</li> <li>Familiarity with Microsoft D365 or a comparable ERP; working knowledge of BlackLine, Sigma, and Alteryx is advantageous.</li> <li>Understanding of SOX internal control requirements in a tax context.</li> <li>Ability to communicate clearly on technical VAT matters to non-specialist colleagues across Legal, Finance, and Commercial functions.</li> <li>Experience managing and leading a team.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Don’t meet every single requirement? That's ok. At Axon, we Aim Far. We think big with a long-term view because we want to reinvent the world to be a safer, better place. We are also committed to building diverse teams that reflect the communities we serve.</p> <p>Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they check every box in the job description. If you’re excited about this role and our mission to Protect Life but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification listed here, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.</p> <p><strong>Important Notes</strong></p> <p><em>The above job description is not intended as, nor should it be construed as, exhaustive of all duties, responsibilities, skills, efforts, or working conditions associated with this job. The job description may change or be supplemented at any time in accordance with business needs and conditions.</em></p> <p><em>Some roles may also require legal eligibility to work in a firearms environment.</em></p> <p><em>We collect personal information from applicants to evaluate candidates for employment. description: Who We Are At Partnerize, we're on a mission to transform the way businesses grow. We've built the leading partnership automation platform that empowers brands to discover, engage, and convert their audiences at scale. From affiliate marketing to influencer collaborations, we help our clients build and manage profitable partnerships that drive real results. We're a team of passionate problem-solvers who are dedicated to helping our clients win in the ever-evolving world of digital marketing. Why Join Us We're looking for passionate, talented people who want to be part of a winning team. At Partnerize, you'll find a culture of collaboration, innovation, and respect. We're guided by our core values, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone can do their best work. We also offer a competitive salary, generous benefits, and a flexible work environment that allows you to thrive both personally and professionally. If you're ready to grow your career and make a difference, we'd love to hear from you. About the Role We're looking for a Senior Platform Engineer to join our engineering team and champion the deployment architecture that drives our platform maturity. You'll be embedded within our engineering teams, optimizing day-to-day delivery across our on-premise estate while acting as the key engineering stakeholder to help shape, configure, and roll out our new Kubernetes platform, modernising how we deploy and scale workloads. This is a hands-on role with real impact. You won't be rubber-stamping tickets; you'll have true autonomy over our CI/CD pipelines, automated guardrails, and migration strategies, shaping how engineering safely and rapidly ships value to production.   What You'll Be Doing BAU & Platform Stability Utilise and contribute to Ansible-based deployment automation to facilitate seamless product feature releases, adhering to established TechOps peer-review processes. Monitor application-level health within the cluster, collaborating with TechOps on incident response and driving post-mortems for engineering-led deployments. Maintain clear documentation, deployment runbooks, and developer self-service guides to streamline the engineering onboarding and release processes. Kubernetes  Represent Engineering as a key stakeholder in platform design: Collaborate with TechOps to shape engineering self-service workflows, guardrails, and standards. This includes contributing requirements for Kubernetes primitives (such as Gateway API, RBAC, admission controllers, and resource policies) to ensure engineering teams can move fast safely, without compromising core platform stability. Standardise application-level configurations: Work alongside TechOps to establish clear engineering standards within the namespaces for ingress, RBAC, namespacing strategy, and secrets management. Drive phased application migrations: Partner with engineering teams to containerise and migrate existing workloads to Kubernetes, starting with non-critical environments to establish confidence before moving business-critical systems. Build robust deployment pipelines: Establish CI/CD workflows for Kubernetes-based deployments (using Helm, Kustomize, ArgoCD, or similar) with automated guardrails to ensure fast, repeatable, and safe code delivery. Implement application observability: Set up application-level metrics, logging, and alerting within the namespaces, ensuring engineering teams have the visibility they need to monitor workload health. Create developer self-service documentation: Document deployment runbooks, manifest templates, and best practices so that engineers can onboard and self-serve safely within the established guardrails.   What We're Looking For Must-Have Strong interpersonal and communication skills : we're a people-first culture where teamwork is paramount. On highly technical projects with many moving parts, the ability to collaborate openly, communicate clearly, and bring people with you is just as important as technical ability Strong, demonstrable experience with Ansible : roles, inventories, vault, idempotency, the lot Comfortable with Docker and Docker Compose in production environments Understanding of networking fundamentals Strong scripting ability: Bash and Python Experience with GitOps tooling: ArgoCD or Flux Experience with observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Alertmanager or equivalent) Ability to think creatively within constraints and plan pragmatically around them: our stack is real-world, not greenfield-perfect, and we need someone who can deliver iteratively, working with what exists today while roadmapping towards the ideal state A methodical, security-conscious approach Nice-to-Have Familiarity with Helm chart authoring and management Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform (even in an on-prem context) Experience with secrets management tooling (HashiCorp Vault, Sealed Secrets, External Secrets Operator) Prior experience in a role where you balanced greenfield work alongside BAU responsibilities   The Kind of Person We're After You're comfortable being the person engineering teams come to when something's on fire, and you're also comfortable saying "let me schedule that properly" when it isn't You can hold your own in a conversation with a software engineer, a network engineer, and senior leadership  even if they all want different things You write things down. Runbooks and diagrams: you treat documentation as part of the job, not an afterthought You have opinions about how things should be done, but you're pragmatic; you know when to pick the right tool vs. the perfect tool Autonomously drive outcomes : we're looking for people who demonstrate intent and take initiative, not those who wait to be told what to do next   What We Offer True ownership of the delivery lifecycle: The autonomy to shape how we ship code, build pipelines, and automate guardrails, moving entirely away from manual ticket execution. A pivotal role in our cloud-native transformation: The opportunity to act as the key engineering stakeholder shaping our migration to Kubernetes, partnering closely with TechOps to build a modern, scalable platform.  A progressive engineering culture: A collaborative, forward-thinking team that values automation, continuous improvement, and building modern delivery standards.   We welcome applications from candidates who don't tick every box. If you've got strong Ansible and Kubernetes experience and the right mindset, we'd love to hear from you. UK Benefits & Perks 25 days holiday in addition to bank holidays  Enhanced Parental Leave: 6 months full pay for birth parent, 4 weeks non-birth parent at full pay after one year employment 5 extra 'Partnerize Parental Days' each year Private Medical and Dental Insurance  Enhanced pension contributions Cycle to Work scheme  Eye Care Vouchers  Life Assurance Enhanced Wellness Program including access to EAP, Wellness Coaching & Wellness Programs Regular company events and activities Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion We are committed to attracting, developing, and advancing our outstanding team members, regardless of race, ethnic identity, sexual orientation, religion, age, gender, gender identity, physical abilities, or any other dimension of diversity. We strive to foster an environment where people can be their authentic selves, raise concerns and innovate, all without fear; where they are treated fairly and respectfully, have equal access to opportunities and resources and can contribute fully to the organization's success. Every individual in our business is expected to live this commitment without exception. Privacy and data protection . The data collected as part of this application will be used for the recruitment process and any subsequent employment. You can find further information in Partnerize privacy policy here:  https://partnerize.com/privacy-policy/ Notice to Recruiters and Staffing Agencies: To protect the interests of all parties, Partnerize will not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than directly from a candidate or an approved vendor that has a written and signed agreement in place with Partnerize. What You'll Be Doing

BAU & Platform Stability

  • Utilise and contribute to Ansible-based deployment automation to facilitate seamless product feature releases, adhering to established TechOps peer-review processes.
  • Monitor application-level health within the cluster, collaborating with TechOps on incident response and driving post-mortems for engineering-led deployments.
  • Maintain clear documentation, deployment runbooks, and developer self-service guides to streamline the engineering onboarding and release processes.

Kubernetes 

  • Represent Engineering as a key stakeholder in platform design: Collaborate with TechOps to shape engineering self-service workflows, guardrails, and standards.   • Standardise application-level configurations: Work alongside TechOps to establish clear engineering standards within the namespaces for ingress, RBAC, namespacing strategy, and secrets management.
  • Drive phased application migrations: Partner with engineering teams to containerise and migrate existing workloads to Kubernetes, starting with non-critical environments to establish confidence before moving business-critical systems.
  • Build robust deployment pipelines: Establish CI/CD workflows for Kubernetes-based deployments (using Helm, Kustomize, ArgoCD, or similar) with automated guardrails to ensure fast, repeatable, and safe code delivery.
  • Implement application observability: Set up application-level metrics, logging, and alerting within the namespaces, ensuring engineering teams have the visibility they need to monitor workload health.

Must-Have

  • Strong scripting ability: Bash and Python
  • Experience with GitOps tooling: ArgoCD or Flux
  • Experience with observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Alertmanager or equivalent)

  • A methodical, security-conscious approach

Nice-to-Have

  • Familiarity with Helm chart authoring and management
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform (even in an on-prem context)
  • Experience with secrets management tooling (HashiCorp Vault, Sealed Secrets, External Secrets Operator)
  • Prior experience in a role where you balanced greenfield work alongside BAU responsibilities

raw.description:
Who We Are

At Partnerize, we're on a mission to transform the way businesses grow. We've built the leading partnership automation platform that empowers brands to discover, engage, and convert their audiences at scale. From affiliate marketing to influencer collaborations, we help our clients build and manage profitable partnerships that drive real results. We're a team of passionate problem-solvers who are dedicated to helping our clients win in the ever-evolving world of digital marketing.

Why Join Us

We're looking for passionate, talented people who want to be part of a winning team. At Partnerize, you'll find a culture of collaboration, innovation, and respect. We're guided by our core values, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone can do their best work. We also offer a competitive salary, generous benefits, and a flexible work environment that allows you to thrive both personally and professionally. If you're ready to grow your career and make a difference, we'd love to hear from you.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Platform Engineer to join our engineering team and champion the deployment architecture that drives our platform maturity. You'll be embedded within our engineering teams, optimizing day-to-day delivery across our on-premise estate while acting as the key engineering stakeholder to help shape, configure, and roll out our new Kubernetes platform, modernising how we deploy and scale workloads.

This is a hands-on role with real impact. You won't be rubber-stamping tickets; you'll have true autonomy over our CI/CD pipelines, automated guardrails, and migration strategies, shaping how engineering safely and rapidly ships value to production.

 

What You'll Be Doing

BAU & Platform Stability

  • Utilise and contribute to Ansible-based deployment automation to facilitate seamless product feature releases, adhering to established TechOps peer-review processes.
  • Monitor application-level health within the cluster, collaborating with TechOps on incident response and driving post-mortems for engineering-led deployments.
  • Maintain clear documentation, deployment runbooks, and developer self-service guides to streamline the engineering onboarding and release processes.

Kubernetes 

  • Represent Engineering as a key stakeholder in platform design: Collaborate with TechOps to shape engineering self-service workflows, guardrails, and standards. This includes contributing requirements for Kubernetes primitives (such as Gateway API, RBAC, admission controllers, and resource policies) to ensure engineering teams can move fast safely, without compromising core platform stability.
  • Standardise application-level configurations: Work alongside TechOps to establish clear engineering standards within the namespaces for ingress, RBAC, namespacing strategy, and secrets management.
  • Drive phased application migrations: Partner with engineering teams to containerise and migrate existing workloads to Kubernetes, starting with non-critical environments to establish confidence before moving business-critical systems.
  • Build robust deployment pipelines: Establish CI/CD workflows for Kubernetes-based deployments (using Helm, Kustomize, ArgoCD, or similar) with automated guardrails to ensure fast, repeatable, and safe code delivery.
  • Implement application observability: Set up application-level metrics, logging, and alerting within the namespaces, ensuring engineering teams have the visibility they need to monitor workload health.
  • Create developer self-service documentation: Document deployment runbooks, manifest templates, and best practices so that engineers can onboard and self-serve safely within the established guardrails.

 

What We're Looking For

Must-Have

  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills: we're a people-first culture where teamwork is paramount. On highly technical projects with many moving parts, the ability to collaborate openly, communicate clearly, and bring people with you is just as important as technical ability
  • Strong, demonstrable experience with Ansible: roles, inventories, vault, idempotency, the lot
  • Comfortable with Docker and Docker Compose in production environments
  • Understanding of networking fundamentals
  • Strong scripting ability: Bash and Python
  • Experience with GitOps tooling: ArgoCD or Flux
  • Experience with observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Alertmanager or equivalent)
  • Ability to think creatively within constraints and plan pragmatically around them: our stack is real-world, not greenfield-perfect, and we need someone who can deliver iteratively, working with what exists today while roadmapping towards the ideal state
  • A methodical, security-conscious approach

Nice-to-Have

  • Familiarity with Helm chart authoring and management
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform (even in an on-prem context)
  • Experience with secrets management tooling (HashiCorp Vault, Sealed Secrets, External Secrets Operator)
  • Prior experience in a role where you balanced greenfield work alongside BAU responsibilities

 

The Kind of Person We're After

  • You're comfortable being the person engineering teams come to when something's on fire, and you're also comfortable saying "let me schedule that properly" when it isn't
  • You can hold your own in a conversation with a software engineer, a network engineer, and senior leadership  even if they all want different things
  • You write things down. Runbooks and diagrams: you treat documentation as part of the job, not an afterthought
  • You have opinions about how things should be done, but you're pragmatic; you know when to pick the right tool vs. the perfect tool
  • Autonomously drive outcomes: we're looking for people who demonstrate intent and take initiative, not those who wait to be told what to do next

 

What We Offer

  • True ownership of the delivery lifecycle: The autonomy to shape how we ship code, build pipelines, and automate guardrails, moving entirely away from manual ticket execution.
  • A pivotal role in our cloud-native transformation: The opportunity to act as the key engineering stakeholder shaping our migration to Kubernetes, partnering closely with TechOps to build a modern, scalable platform.
  •  A progressive engineering culture: A collaborative, forward-thinking team that values automation, continuous improvement, and building modern delivery standards.

 

We welcome applications from candidates who don't tick every box. If you've got strong Ansible and Kubernetes experience and the right mindset, we'd love to hear from you.

UK Benefits & Perks

  • 25 days holiday in addition to bank holidays 
  • Enhanced Parental Leave: 6 months full pay for birth parent, 4 weeks non-birth parent at full pay after one year employment
  • 5 extra 'Partnerize Parental Days' each year
  • Private Medical and Dental Insurance 
  • Enhanced pension contributions
  • Cycle to Work scheme 
  • Eye Care Vouchers 
  • Life Assurance
  • Enhanced Wellness Program including access to EAP, Wellness Coaching & Wellness Programs
  • Regular company events and activities

Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

We are committed to attracting, developing, and advancing our outstanding team members, regardless of race, ethnic identity, sexual orientation, religion, age, gender, gender identity, physical abilities, or any other dimension of diversity. We strive to foster an environment where people can be their authentic selves, raise concerns and innovate, all without fear; where they are treated fairly and respectfully, have equal access to opportunities and resources and can contribute fully to the organization's success. Every individual in our business is expected to live this commitment without exception.

Privacy and data protection. The data collected as part of this application will be used for the recruitment process and any subsequent employment. You can find further information in Partnerize privacy policy here: https://partnerize.com/privacy-policy/

Notice to Recruiters and Staffing Agencies: To protect the interests of all parties, Partnerize will not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than directly from a candidate or an approved vendor that has a written and signed agreement in place with Partnerize. Please do not contact or forward resumes to our company employees or locations. Any unsolicited resumes will be considered Partnerize property. Partnerize is not responsible for any charges or fees related to unsolicited resumes.

raw.description:
Who We Are

At Partnerize, we're on a mission to transform the way businesses grow. We've built the leading partnership automation platform that empowers brands to discover, engage, and convert their audiences at scale. From affiliate marketing to influencer collaborations, we help our clients build and manage profitable partnerships that drive real results. We're a team of passionate problem-solvers who are dedicated to helping our clients win in the ever-evolving world of digital marketing.

Why Join Us

We're looking for passionate, talented people who want to be part of a winning team. At Partnerize, you'll find a culture of collaboration, innovation, and respect. We're guided by our core values, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone can do their best work. We also offer a competitive salary, generous benefits, and a flexible work environment that allows you to thrive both personally and professionally. If you're ready to grow your career and make a difference, we'd love to hear from you.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Platform Engineer to join our engineering team and champion the deployment architecture that drives our platform maturity. You'll be embedded within our engineering teams, optimizing day-to-day delivery across our on-premise estate while acting as the key engineering stakeholder to help shape, configure, and roll out our new Kubernetes platform, modernising how we deploy and scale workloads.

This is a hands-on role with real impact. You won't be rubber-stamping tickets; you'll have true autonomy over our CI/CD pipelines, automated guardrails, and migration strategies, shaping how engineering safely and rapidly ships value to production.

 

What You'll Be Doing

BAU & Platform Stability

  • Utilise and contribute to Ansible-based deployment automation to facilitate seamless product feature releases, adhering to established TechOps peer-review processes.
  • Monitor application-level health within the cluster, collaborating with TechOps on incident response and driving post-mortems for engineering-led deployments.
  • Maintain clear documentation, deployment runbooks, and developer self-service guides to streamline the engineering onboarding and release processes.

Kubernetes 

  • Represent Engineering as a key stakeholder in platform design: Collaborate with TechOps to shape engineering self-service workflows, guardrails, and standards. This includes contributing requirements for Kubernetes primitives (such as Gateway API, RBAC, admission controllers, and resource policies) to ensure engineering teams can move fast safely, without compromising core platform stability.
  • Standardise application-level configurations: Work alongside TechOps to establish clear engineering standards within the namespaces for ingress, RBAC, namespacing strategy, and secrets management.
  • Drive phased application migrations: Partner with engineering teams to containerise and migrate existing workloads to Kubernetes, starting with non-critical environments to establish confidence before moving business-critical systems.
  • Build robust deployment pipelines: Establish CI/CD workflows for Kubernetes-based deployments (using Helm, Kustomize, ArgoCD, or similar) with automated guardrails to ensure fast, repeatable, and safe code delivery.
  • Implement application observability: Set up application-level metrics, logging, and alerting within the namespaces, ensuring engineering teams have the visibility they need to monitor workload health.
  • Create developer self-service documentation: Document deployment runbooks, manifest templates, and best practices so that engineers can onboard and self-serve safely within the established guardrails.

 

What We're Looking For

Must-Have

  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills: we're a people-first culture where teamwork is paramount. On highly technical projects with many moving parts, the ability to collaborate openly, communicate clearly, and bring people with you is just as important as technical ability
  • Strong, demonstrable experience with Ansible: roles, inventories, vault, idempotency, the lot
  • Comfortable with Docker and Docker Compose in production environments
  • Understanding of networking fundamentals
  • Strong scripting ability: Bash and Python
  • Experience with GitOps tooling: ArgoCD or Flux
  • Experience with observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Alertmanager or equivalent)
  • Ability to think creatively within constraints and plan pragmatically around them: our stack is real-world, not greenfield-perfect, and we need someone who can deliver iteratively, working with what exists today while roadmapping towards the ideal state
  • A methodical, security-conscious approach

Nice-to-Have

  • Familiarity with Helm chart authoring and management
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform (even in an on-prem context)
  • Experience with secrets management tooling (HashiCorp Vault, Sealed Secrets, External Secrets Operator)
  • Prior experience in a role where you balanced greenfield work alongside BAU responsibilities

 

The Kind of Person We're After

  • You're comfortable being the person engineering teams come to when something's on fire, and you're also comfortable saying "let me schedule that properly" when it isn't
  • You can hold your own in a conversation with a software engineer, a network engineer, and senior leadership  even if they all want different things
  • You write things down. Runbooks and diagrams: you treat documentation as part of the job, not an afterthought
  • You have opinions about how things should be done, but you're pragmatic; you know when to pick the right tool vs. the perfect tool
  • Autonomously drive outcomes: we're looking for people who demonstrate intent and take initiative, not those who wait to be told what to do next

 

What We Offer

  • True ownership of the delivery lifecycle: The autonomy to shape how we ship code, build pipelines, and automate guardrails, moving entirely away from manual ticket execution.
  • A pivotal role in our cloud-native transformation: The opportunity to act as the key engineering stakeholder shaping our migration to Kubernetes, partnering closely with TechOps to build a modern, scalable platform.
  •  A progressive engineering culture: A collaborative, forward-thinking team that values automation, continuous improvement, and building modern delivery standards.

 

We welcome applications from candidates who don't tick every box. If you've got strong Ansible and Kubernetes experience and the right mindset, we'd love to hear from you.

UK Benefits & Perks

  • 25 days holiday in addition to bank holidays 
  • Enhanced Parental Leave: 6 months full pay for birth parent, 4 weeks non-birth parent at full pay after one year employment
  • 5 extra 'Partnerize Parental Days' each year
  • Private Medical and Dental Insurance 
  • Enhanced pension contributions
  • Cycle to Work scheme 
  • Eye Care Vouchers 
  • Life Assurance
  • Enhanced Wellness Program including access to EAP, Wellness Coaching & Wellness Programs
  • Regular company events and activities

Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

We are committed to attracting, developing, and advancing our outstanding team members, regardless of race, ethnic identity, sexual orientation, religion, age, gender, gender identity, physical abilities, or any other dimension of diversity. We strive to foster an environment where people can be their authentic selves, raise concerns and innovate, all without fear; where they are treated fairly and respectfully, have equal access to opportunities and resources and can contribute fully to the organization's success. Every individual in our business is expected to live this commitment without exception.

title: Senior Animator
description: The multi-Oscar-winning creative Film & Episodic Studio at Framestore has worked with some of the greatest storytellers in film today. Collaborating with directors and producers across the complete filmmaking process to help design, plan and create beautiful images, we focus on finding innovative creative solutions to support their vision and set new standards for visual effects in cinema. Framestore combines talent and technology to bring life to everything we create. Driven by creativity and inspired by the future, we set out every day to reframe the possible. About the role This is an existing role within our team. As a Senior Animator, you'll be a key creative force in breathing life, weight, and personality into complex three-dimensional characters and photorealistic creatures. You’ll jump straight into the heart of our storytelling, crafting everything from nuanced, emotional facial expressions to epic, high-action combat performances. If you have a passion for mastering complex anatomy and love the challenge of making mythical beasts—whether they walk, fly, or breathe fire—feel completely grounded in reality, this is the place to do it. What you’ll do Collaborate closely with your Animation Lead and Supervisor to produce premium, story-driven animation that elevates the pacing and style of the film. Partner with our Rigging and Pipeline teams, sharing direct feedback to refine character setups, enhance visual quality, and build smoother tool workflows. Animate both primary and secondary characters, ensuring every element in the frame possesses authentic motion and soul. Take ownership of your workflow, keeping production schedules transparent and hitting your deadlines consistently. Mentor and support less senior artists, sharing your craft and helping them grow their skills. Actively tackle creative changes and follow through constructively on supervisor notes and technical feedback. Significant experience animating on large-scale, photorealistic VFX projects, with a showreel that highlights exceptional creature and character performances. Deep production knowledge of Maya. A natural grasp of physical motion, weight, balance, and spatial awareness. A strong foundation in human and animal anatomy, which underpins how you animate complex fantasy muscle structures and locomotion. An understanding of character rigs, animation pipelines, and data transfer between production tools. Clear, constructive communication and a genuinely collaborative approach to working across distributed pipeline teams. Adaptability, an open mind for direction, and a calm, reliable focus when deadlines approach. You might also have Experience working with, clean-up, or editing of motion capture data. A traditional background in sketching, life drawing, or classic 2D animation. A working knowledge of Modelling or basic scripting (Python/MEL) to streamline workflows. Accessibility Statement Our London studio is fully accessible, with step-free entry, accessible toilets on all floors, and quiet spaces available. From subscriptions and prepaid products to pricing updates and promotional campaigns, our tools support business-critical operations through intuitive experiences, trusted workflows, and reliable platform services. As a Fullstack Engineer, you'll develop end-to-end solutions spanning modern web applications, backend services, and data platforms. Working closely with engineers, product managers, designers, and business partners, you'll help create the tools that enable Spotify's global subscription business to innovate safely, efficiently, and at scale. What You'll Do Build end-to-end features across modern web applications, backend services, and data platforms that support Spotify's global subscription business. Create intuitive internal products that enable business teams to launch, configure, and manage Premium offers through secure, guided workflows. Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services that power subscriptions, prepaid products, pricing, promotions, and the offer lifecycle. Develop GraphQL and gRPC APIs that connect frontend applications with distributed platform services. Design efficient database schemas, implement data migrations, and optimize application performance using PostgreSQL. Build secure, reliable, and auditable systems that support business-critical financial operations and SOX-compliant approval workflows. Collaborate with engineers across the Subscriptions Mission to evolve shared platform capabilities, improve developer experience, and increase platform reliability. Write maintainable, well-tested code while contributing to technical design, architecture discussions, code reviews, and continuous improvement. Participate in an on-call rotation to help maintain the reliability and availability of services powering Spotify Premium. Who You Are You have experience building and delivering production software across both frontend and backend technologies. You have experience developing scalable backend services using modern Java, with Java 17+ experience being a plus. You have built modern web applications using TypeScript, React, and Next.js. You have experience designing or consuming GraphQL APIs and enjoy building schema-driven applications. You have worked with gRPC services and Protocol Buffers, or you're excited to deepen your expertise in distributed systems. You have hands-on experience with PostgreSQL or another relational database, including schema design, migrations, and query optimization. You enjoy partnering with engineers, designers, product managers, and business stakeholders to solve complex problems and deliver meaningful outcomes. You have a passion for simplifying complex workflows and creating intuitive experiences for internal users. Experience with tools such as jOOQ, Flyway, Apollo GraphQL, DataLoader, Styled Components, Storybook, TanStack Query, Tailwind CSS, Material UI, or similar technologies will help you ramp up quickly. Experience building commerce platforms, subscription products, pricing systems, distributed systems, or large-scale platform modernization initiatives is beneficial. Where You'll Be We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! For this role, you can be within the EMEA region as long as we have a work location.
